name: kensho-kclub
description: Read-only MCP server exposing the kensho Japan X/Twitter sweepstakes dataset from kenshou.club (additional sweepstakes source for Kensho collection). Kenshou.club archives tagged with 'twitterで応募' provides 50-200+ sweepstakes entries per run.
long_description: Exposes the accumulated kensho Japan sweepstakes dataset from kenshou.club as three read-only MCP tools: current_sweep (latest match), sweep_history (time series), and top_prize_movers (biggest value changes). Pure local data, zero dependencies beyond fastmcp. Ideal for AI agents researching Japanese X/Twitter giveaways.

input.title: Input schema for kensho-kclub
input.description: kensho-kclub is a read-only MCP server. It requires no input parameters — start it and connect an MCP client to discover its tools. All data is bundled locally; no network, no API key, no account.

output.title: Output schema of kensho-kclub
output.description: kensho-kclub exposes a Streamable HTTP MCP server on the Apify standby container. It produces no dataset or key-value store output; its result is the MCP tool interface itself. Connect an MCP client to the standby URL and call sweepstakes tools.

tools.name: current_sweep
tools.description: Latest sweep matching keyword in the kensho Japan sweepstakes dataset from kenshou.club.

keyword.description: item name, prize, or URL substring (e.g. "Amazonギフト", "iPhone", "リザードン").

tools.name: sweep_history
tools.description: Time series of sweeps matching keyword in the kensho dataset from kenshou.club.

keyword.description: item name, prize, or URL substring.

limit.description: max number of history rows to return (default 50).

tools.name: top_prize_movers
tools.description: Biggest prize value movers in the kensho sweepstakes dataset from kenshou.club (ranked by |delta JPY|).

direction.description: None/"both" = up+down, "up" = value rose, "down" = value fell.
